# Generic2LLPseudopotentials

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/Generic2LLPseudopotentials`

```text
Delta2LLPseudopotentials, version 0.01

Usage: Delta2LLPseudopotentials [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -s, --nbr-flux : number of flux quanta (i.e. twice the maximum momentum for a single particle on LLL) (default value = 8)
    --interaction-type : type of interaction to generate pseudo-potentials for (delta, laplaciandelta or coulomb support at pressent). Default: delta
    --interaction-name : name to use to identify pseudo-potential file. Default is the interaction-type which by default is delta
    -c, --odd-factor : factor to use to multiply odd pseudopotential terms by (ie terms with odd numbers acting on upper and lower levels). (default value = 1)

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
